title: Three years with the Georgia Minstrels and Freddie Jones
summary: French spent three years with the minstrel show; they try to recall the bandleader, Freddie Jones, and other soft-playing trombonists.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how
